about: Building outlines around each place on the map's Simulation tab, from OpenStreetMap via the Overpass API, downloaded 2026-11-27 by tools/fetch_footprints.mjs. © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0. Cartographic. Each place is a square 800 m across; points are metres east and north of its centre (lon, lat), rounded to 0.5 m. Only outlines: no heights. Buildings missing from OpenStreetMap are missing here.
